current_state.zh: Ethereum mainnet executed its first atomic L1-to-L2 cross-chain transaction, marking the first mainnet implementation of atomic synchronous composability according to Ethereum Economic Zone contributor Eduardo Antuña.

updates.what_changed_zh:
Ethereum Economic Zone（EEZ）核心贡献者 Eduardo Antuña 发推表示，以太坊主网已成功执行首笔从 L1 至 L2 的原子跨链交易。据其表述，原子同步可组合性不再停留于理论阶段，而是正式进入主网实践。

这笔交易被视为原子同步可组合性的首次主网落地，而这一特性此前主要停留在研究与 rollup 互操作性提案的讨论层面。

该说法来自 EEZ 的一位贡献者，描述的是一笔主网上的首笔交易，而非全网范围的协议升级，也不是已被广泛采用并验证的部署标准。来源未披露交易哈希、区块高度、Gas 成本或所涉及的 L2。

updates.background_zh: Ethereum Economic Zone（EEZ）由 Gnosis 与零知识虚拟机项目 Zisk 提出，是一个旨在将二层 rollup 与基础网络更紧密连接的框架。同步可组合性把以太坊的原子执行模型扩展到 rollup 之间：在 L1 上，智能合约可在单笔交易中相互同步调用，所有调用一并执行，要么全部成功，要么整笔交易回滚。向 rollup 扩容使这一模型被割裂，ethresear.ch 等研究讨论将同步可组合性与 intents 视为实现以太坊全域互操作性的两条竞争路径。
updates.background_en: The Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ) was unveiled by Gnosis and zero-knowledge virtual machine project Zisk as a framework aimed at linking layer-2 rollups more tightly to the base network. Synchronous composability extends Ethereum's atomic execution model across rollups: on L1, smart contracts can call each other synchronously within a single transaction, so all calls execute together and either all succeed or the whole transaction reverts. Scaling to rollups fragmented this model, and research threads such as those on ethresear.ch frame synchronous composability and intents as two competing paths to Ethereum-wide interoperability.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于跨链互操作性与 DeFi 可组合性架构：如果原子化的 L1 至 L2 执行成为可用标准，可能改变流动性与合约调用在 rollup 之间的路由方式，以及哪些 L2 交易场所可在单笔交易中从 L1 触达。由于这只是一项由单一项目贡献者披露的初步概念验证，短期内其市场传导仅限于 L2 互操作性叙事，尚未改变任何已部署协议的实际行为。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through cross-chain interoperability and DeFi composability architecture: if atomic L1-to-L2 execution becomes a usable standard, it could change how liquidity and contract calls are routed across rollups and which L2 venues are reachable from L1 in a single transaction. As an initial proof of concept reported by one project contributor, the immediate market read-through is confined to the L2 interoperability narrative rather than to any change in deployed protocol behavior.
